# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for ferntree.
#
# The tree uses *optimistic lock coupling* (LeanStore / Umbra). Writes happen
# under exclusive `HybridLatch` ownership, so no other write can race. Reads
# come in two flavours:
#
#   1. Shared / exclusive guards — fully synchronised via the `RwLock` inside
#      the latch; TSan sees and accepts these.
#   2. Optimistic guards — load the version counter, do non-atomic reads of
#      latched data, then `recheck()` the version to validate. If a writer
#      ran concurrently, the version-counter recheck fails and the loaded
#      data is discarded *without dereferencing*.
#
# TSan models happens-before edges through atomic ops on the *same address*.
# Our optimistic reads race-load `Atomic<HybridLatch<...>>` pointers while a
# writer is inside `mem::replace` on the same field — the synchronisation is
# provided by the latch's *version counter* (a different address), which TSan
# can't see. This is a well-known limitation of TSan for OLC structures and
# is also why `crossbeam-epoch` ships its own suppression list.
#
# The protocol's correctness is proven separately by the loom tests, which
# explore all interleavings of the version-counter handshake.

# Race in `mem::replace<Atomic<HybridLatch<...>>>` during merge/split.
# Writers hold the exclusive parent latch; optimistic readers fail their
# `recheck()` after the writer bumps the version. Substring-matched on
# function name, so this matches the monomorphised `try_merge`/`try_split`
# regardless of the concrete `K, V, IC, LC`.
race:try_merge
race:try_split

# Race in `SmallVec::insert`/`SmallVec::remove`/`SmallVec::push` during
# node mutation. The mutation happens under the node's exclusive latch;
# optimistic readers may load and then fail validation. The `SmallVec`
# inline storage is not internally synchronised — the latch provides the
# ordering.
race:smallvec::SmallVec

# Race on the version counter / RwLock bits via optimistic loads in the
# latch itself. Reads pair with the version counter check rather than
# any acquire on the racing field directly.
race:ferntree::latch::HybridLatch
